clues.text: After Moses stretched out his staff over Egypt, an east wind blew all night and brought them by morning.
When Pharaoh begged for mercy, a strong west wind swept them into the Red Sea.
John the Baptist wore camel's hair and a leather belt, and ate these with wild honey.
In Gideon's day the Midianites invaded Israel with their camels and tents like a great swarm of these.
Among four small but wise things on earth, these have no king yet all advance in formation.
When the fifth angel sounded his trumpet, these came out of the smoke from the Abyss with power like scorpions.
Moses warned Israel that if they disobeyed, they would sow much seed but these would consume it.
